changes: Test release to try updating from inside the app. Nothing else changed.
New: Check for Updates can now install the update for you. Choose Install and restart and the app downloads the new version, replaces itself and reopens.
New: when a newer version is available the app now asks whether to install it, and checks quietly each time it opens. Choose No to skip that version.
Fixed: dismissing a notice or choosing Check for Updates no longer opens Settings by accident.
Release: first published build since 1.0.9, including Check for Updates, version history and the diagnostic report.
Fixed: the window no longer keeps an empty gap at the top after a notice is dismissed.
New: Check for Updates (File menu or Settings) tells you when a newer version is available and links to the download.
Version numbers now match the commit count (1.0.N for commit N), with history backfilled from earlier commits.
New: version history in Settings, and a notice at the top of the app after each update telling you what changed.
New: Save Diagnostic Report (File menu or Settings). Saves a read-only troubleshooting file to your Desktop for when a logger won't read.
